title: How To Use Location Extensions In Google Ads - Store Growers

facts.fact: The Store Growers article 'How To Use Location Extensions In Google Ads' was last updated on 8 January 2026.
According to the page, the Google My Business business name field has a maximum of 80 characters.
According to the page, the Google My Business street address field has a maximum of 80 characters.
According to the page, the Google My Business URL field has a maximum of 35 characters.

According to the page, when adding a location extension to a Google Ads account, the advertiser has three options: select curated locations, find a Google My Business account, or link to a Google My Business account they know.
According to the page, once a Google My Business account is linked, the advertiser can add all synchronized locations, location groups, or no location extension.
According to the page, advertisers pay for clicks that take prospects to their site and also for clicks that give searchers more details on the business location.
facts.quote: You pay for clicks that take your potential customer to your site, but also for clicks that give searchers more details on your location.

facts.fact: According to the page, location extensions can only show up next to Google Search Ads.
facts.quote: Location extensions can only show up next to Google Search Ads.

facts.fact: According to the page, curated locations are mostly bigger chains and are added automatically with all their locations.
